title: When AI performs, what remains? An integrative review of generative AI and cognitive capital in individuals and organizations
abstract: arXiv:2610.38647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence is rapidly entering knowledge work, and its short-term productivity benefits are increasingly documented. Less is known about what happens, over time, to the knowledge, skills and judgment that remain in people and organizations. This integrative narrative review addresses that question through the construct of cognitive capital: the accumulated, renewable and depletable stock of knowledge, cognitive and metacognitive capabilities, and practices that enables an individual or an organization to learn, interpret information, exercise judgment, solve problems and adapt. We distinguish individual and organizational cognitive capital from the capability of the human-AI system, so that gains in joint performance and losses in human capability can be observed at the same time. translated_title: 当AI高效运作时，还剩下什么？关于生成式人工智能与个体及组织认知资本的整合性综述
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能正迅速进入知识工作领域，其短期生产力收益已得到越来越多的记录。然而，随着时间的推移，留存于个人和组织中的知识、技能与判断力会发生什么变化，人们对此知之甚少。本整合性叙述性综述通过“认知资本”这一构念来探讨该问题：认知资本是指积累的、可再生的且可耗竭的知识、认知与元认知能力以及实践的储备，它使个体或组织能够学习、解读信息、运用判断力、解决问题并适应变化。我们将个体与组织层面的认知资本与人机系统的联合能力区分开来，从而能够同时观察到联合绩效的提升与人类能力的损耗。基于实验、实地与概念性研究，我们提出了AI互动影响认知资本的四种机制……
tldr: 本综述提出“认知资本”框架，将个体与组织的认知资本同人机系统能力相区分，并识别出生成式AI影响人类知识、技能与判断力留存或损耗的四种机制。
en_tdlr: This integrative review proposes a "cognitive capital" framework that distinguishes individual and organizational cognitive capital from human-AI system capability, identifying four mechanisms through which generative AI affects the retention or depletion of human knowledge, skills, and judgment.
